authority: PI prospective ruling after SPPPO V1 closure and D0/D1 completion
scientific_question: Which of regime-conditioned payoff scoring, latent-specific centralized value heads, and directed teacher identity is required to preserve the confirmed SAPPO repertoire inside one persistent K=2 controller?

hard_boundaries.SPPPO_V1: CLOSED; its NOT_CONFIRMED verdict is immutable
hard_boundaries.SPPPO_V2_name: FORBIDDEN; this is a fresh supervised-compression method family

D1_complete.finding: Coverage was not the dominant problem; Q_psi has a localized own_flag_stolen ranking failure, while broader evidence still favors policy-side optimization/interference.

classification.why_supported: The fidelity rules explicitly classify deliberate extension mechanisms and compound extension ladders as SUMMER-COMPATIBLE EXTENSION when every deviation is enumerated and the canonical paper-faithful row remains available.
not_paper_faithful_because: z is forced and persistent rather than inferred by q_phi
teacher identities supervise fixed z modes
the actor inherits mode-specific final heads
an external payoff scorer supplies a standalone ranking update
R1 adds explicit handcrafted scorer regimes
R3 adds a directed contrastive teacher objective
classification.allowed_claim: A supervised persistent K=2 controller did or did not preserve a previously confirmed explicit repertoire under the prospectively frozen treatment ladder.
forbidden_claims: RASR-PPO is the Summer or paper-faithful method
the regime signal is available to the decentralized actor
a single matched-initialization ladder establishes robustness over training randomness

parents.S0: exact frozen SPPPO V1 treatment, reproduced only as this study's same-block control

identity.classification: SUMMER-COMPATIBLE EXTENSION; S0 is a diagnostic control arm
identity.research_question: Do the three prospectively isolated mechanisms repair the scorer-regime, value-interference, and directed-identity failures identified by D0/D1?

fidelity_impact.supervision_added_beyond_SPPPO: R3 changes the existing teacher objective from positive-only to directed contrastive identity; teacher mapping is otherwise unchanged
fidelity_impact.auxiliary_task_added: R1 replaces the frozen scorer with a regime-conditioned scorer trained on the same target and data rules

add the four rows and resolved-config deltas to latent-preset-registry.md

keep every existing paper-faithful pinning test green

same_block_control_rule.S0_definition: Exact SPPPO V1 scientific treatment on the new TRAIN block: corrected persistent assigned-pole training, old frozen Q_psi, lambda_R=1.0, ranking margin=0.04, ranking cadence=1:1, ordinary teacher rehearsal lambda=0.1 at 1:4, EXP2C actor architecture, shared critic.
same_block_control_rule.boundary: S0 is not a rerun, repair, reopening, or re-adjudication of SPPPO V1. It is a new-study control needed to isolate successor deltas on the same initialization, training block, and final block.

shared_contract_all_arms.z_lifetime: forced and persistent for the full episode
shared_contract_all_arms.actor: one shared policy object; shared CNN/body; two inherited mode-specific final actor heads
shared_contract_all_arms.PPO_configuration: bit-for-bit SPPPO V1 except the single rung-specific delta
shared_contract_all_arms.teacher_legal_action_masking: identical masked distributions for teacher and student

ranking.cadence: one standalone actor-only ranking update after every PPO update
ranking.optimizer_relationship: separate RankingRunner step, never blended into PPO backward

training_replicates.reason: inherits the established one-canonical-training-seed policy for this supervised-compression branch
training_replicates.claim_limit: matched-initialization causal screen only; not robustness over training randomness

S0.name: same-block SPPPO control
S0.scientific_delta_vs_parent: none; new run identity and fresh reserved seeds only

R1.name: regime-conditioned scorer
R1.only_scientific_delta: replace old Q_psi with the prospectively specified regime-conditioned Q_psi^r

R2.name: latent-specific centralized value heads
R2.only_scientific_delta: replace the shared final critic scalar head with two z-specific scalar heads

R3.name: directed contrastive identity
R3.only_scientific_delta: replace positive-only teacher rehearsal loss with the frozen directed identity loss

causal_ladder.execution_rule: After all implementation and scorer-qualification gates pass, train S0, R1, R2, and R3 independently. No rung's training-side or DEV result may determine whether a later rung trains. FINAL remains unopened until all four terminal checkpoints and hashes are frozen.

R1_regime_scorer_contract.weighting: same episode-normalized plain-row weights and unit branch-row weights
R1_regime_scorer_contract.joint_action_form: same low-rank action-conditioned bilinear Q_psi form

values.0: own flag home, blue not carrying
values.2: own flag stolen, blue not carrying

regime_encoding.own_flag_home: reconstruct the blue flag position from the existing two-agent observation vector and compare with frozen home=(2,10); fail closed on schema or inter-agent reconstruction mismatch
regime_encoding.blue_carrying: any live blue agent has frozen carrying feature index 10 > 0.5
regime_encoding.actor_visibility: NONE; r is scorer-only centralized training context

R1_regime_scorer_contract.architecture_delta: Keep conv, pole embedding, shared state trunk, and action embedding unchanged. Replace the single set of action-conditioned projections (b,u,v,P,Q) with four r-selected projection sets. No other scorer capacity changes.
R1_regime_scorer_contract.initialization: fresh fit with the same frozen torch seed and initialization rules as Phase 0; no warm start from S0 Q_psi
R1_regime_scorer_contract.no_second_scorer: If qualification fails, stop. Do not change target, add samples to fitting, merge regimes, tune head capacity, or train a second scorer.

DEV_scorer_qualification.purpose: fresh validation only; DEV data may never be added to scorer fitting
DEV_scorer_qualification.collection: same rebuild-per-branch semantics as authoritative Phase 0; environment reuse remains forbidden
DEV_scorer_qualification.teachers: same frozen SAPPO pi_A and pi_B
DEV_scorer_qualification.states: decision-eligible branch states from all four teacher/pole paths
DEV_scorer_qualification.primary_gate: LCB95(d_A_r)>0 and LCB95(d_B_r)>0 for each r in {0,1,2,3}
DEV_scorer_qualification.specific_D1_repair_gate: LCB95(d_B_stolen_R1 - d_B_stolen_S0)>0, where stolen pools r in {2,3}
DEV_scorer_qualification.support_validity: Each pole/regime cell must contain rows from at least 32 distinct DEV seeds; otherwise qualification is INVALID and the ladder stops without data growth.

bootstrap.unit: DEV seed; retain every state belonging to a sampled seed
bootstrap.procedure: paired percentile bootstrap; compare S0 and R1 on byte-identical states and masks

secondary_reports_not_gates: prediction range and calibration by regime
DEV_scorer_qualification.if_fail: Freeze SCORER_QUALIFICATION_FAIL and stop before all four 1M policy runs. No replacement scorer is authorized.

R2_private_critic_contract.mathematical_object: centralized scalar V_phi(s,z), never V(o) and never counterfactual Q(s,a')
R2_private_critic_contract.architecture_delta: Keep the entire R1 centralized critic input and shared 128-128 trunk unchanged. Replace only the final shared scalar projection with head_V0 and head_V1, selected by z.
R2_private_critic_contract.initial_function_equivalence: Copy the ordinary shared scalar head weights and bias into both private heads so R1 and R2 value outputs are exactly equal for z0 and z1 before training.
R2_private_critic_contract.gradient_routing: z0 rows update head_V0 and not head_V1; z1 rows update head_V1 and not head_V0. Shared trunk remains shared.
R2_private_critic_contract.GAE_and_returns: Each row's value, bootstrap value, clipped value loss, and GAE use its selected z head; no cross-mode baseline mixing.
R2_private_critic_contract.optimizer: existing PPO optimizer only; no new critic optimizer, coefficient, cadence, or value target

R3_directed_identity_contract.coefficient_rule: The inherited teacher lambda 0.1 multiplies the whole directed loss; no additional beta or tunable coefficient exists.
R3_directed_identity_contract.cadence: one directed teacher update per four completed PPO actor minibatch updates, floor rule, no trailing update
R3_directed_identity_contract.optimizer_relationship: same separate AnchorRunner optimizer step as ordinary rehearsal; never blended into PPO or RankingRunner backward
R3_directed_identity_contract.masking: teacher and both student modes use the same legal-action mask on byte-identical observations
R3_directed_identity_contract.why_zero_margin: Freezes the required direction without inventing an uncalibrated effect-size hyperparameter after seeing SPPPO's identity failure.

decision_logic_after_FINAL.S0_passes: Do not rewrite the closed SPPPO V1 verdict. Record that the same-block control passed at this matched initialization; successor-necessity evidence is inconclusive and EXP3 remains locked pending a separate PI ruling.
decision_logic_after_FINAL.S0_fails_and_one_or_more_successor_arms_: Select the earliest passing rung as the minimal successful treatment. Claims about the specific mechanism additionally require its frozen ablation-success comparison to pass.
decision_logic_after_FINAL.R3_passes: The full Regime-Aware Strategic Role PPO bundle is confirmed at this matched initialization only if R3 passes every unchanged absolute gate.
decision_logic_after_FINAL.no_successor_arm_passes: Freeze the negative ladder and stop. No R4, no larger identity margin, no coefficient sweep, no new scorer target, no extra seeds, and no automatic successor variant.
decision_logic_after_FINAL.EXP3_unlock: NOT AUTOMATIC from this single-training-seed causal screen. A passing rung identifies the candidate for a separately prospectively authorized multi-training-seed confirmation required by the repository headline protocol.

stopping_and_immutability.valid_arm_training_result: never extend, resume for more budget, or replace with an intermediate checkpoint
stopping_and_immutability.mechanical_invalidity: freeze the failed attempt and repair only the violated implementation contract; restart that arm from timestep zero before any FINAL access
forbidden_after_any_DEV_or_FINAL_result: identity margin, coefficient, cadence, or optimizer change

next_and_only_next: Commit this design freeze and its three CLEAN audit artifacts. Do not implement or launch until a separate PI authorization explicitly opens the implementation phase.
